episodes.synopsis: Japan explains the true nature of a ninja's shuriken. Wartime leaves the Axis with a lack of coffee, and Germany is assigned to come up with an alternative. Italy shows off his new tanks, which prove to be quite dangerous.
episodes.title: Each Battlefield

episodes.synopsis: The newspaper club, which consists of Germany, Italy, and Japan, decide to interview all of the clubs in the school, including the choir club, the Soviet club, the hero club, the Gourmet club, and the magic club.
episodes.title: Gakuen Hetalia: Go Forth! Newspaper Club!! (1)

episodes.synopsis: The newspaper club goes on to interview the Nordic club, the Canada club, the elephant appreciation club, the music club, the swim team, and the... "Going Home" club?
episodes.title: Gakuen Hetalia: Go Forth! Newspaper Club!! (2)

episodes.synopsis: Little Russia is picked on by Mongolia, Denmark, and Sweden, is freaked out by Little Ukraine, is rejected by a hamster, and fights the Battle on the Ice against the Teutonic Order (Prussia).
episodes.title: Russia and Friends

episodes.synopsis: After meeting France, a Parisian mortal ponders what it means to live forever.
episodes.title: Though I May Depart, You Shall Remain

episodes.synopsis: In which Chibi Romano is a cute tsundere who really does care for Spain (even though he has an odd way of showing it).
episodes.title: Romano's Diary

episodes.synopsis: Japan stays over at America's place for a while. Extreme culture-conflict ensues.
episodes.title: Things that Often Happen When Rooming with an American

episodes.synopsis: Estonia finds all his websites hacked with each site displaying a drawing of Chibi Russia. Immediately, Estonia accuses Russia of the dirty deed, but naturally Russia denies it. In order to solve the mystery, Estonia hires America to trace the hack.
episodes.title: The Gentle Fight Between Russia and I

episodes.synopsis: The reason for Netherlands' obsessive concern about money is revealed.
episodes.title: At Netherlands

episodes.synopsis: Greece's philosophical side makes an appearance, and more is revealed about his strange relationship with Turkey. Meanwhile, Italy and Turkey discuss the times when Chibitalia used to beat up Turkey, much to the surprise and disbelief of Germany.
episodes.title: "Turkey&!"

episodes.synopsis: All of the countries are threatened with "embarrassing" photos to come to an April Fool's gathering in even more embarrassing costumes.
episodes.title: Our Failure

episodes.synopsis: It's Halloween night, and America wants Japan to help him finally win a Halloween prank war against undefeated England.
episodes.title: Merry Halloween!

episodes.synopsis: Santa's missing and Finland is in a crisis, so he pleads for the other nations to spread the holiday cheer this Christmas until Santa can be found.
episodes.title: Finding Santa

episodes.synopsis: The countries are rated by how fast they walk. Prussia and Germany are caught infiltrating an American military camp.
episodes.title: Brother, we are...!!

episodes.synopsis: France meets a girl and takes her on a tour. They discuss the Hundred Years War, Joan of Arc, and what she means to France.
episodes.title: A bientôt! Until We Meet Again!

episodes.synopsis: England tells Seychelles that the Prince of England and his wife are going to her place for their honeymoon, but she must keep it secret. In another story, Italy forgets his gun during WW1, which is later found by Germany.
episodes.title: What Italy Forgot

episodes.synopsis: The countries watch and discuss horror films from each of their countries.
episodes.title: Hetalia of the Dead (1)

episodes.synopsis: The countries watch more horror films, and realize that horror films from other countries are weird. India and New Zealand make an appearance.
episodes.title: Hetalia of the Dead (2)

episodes.synopsis: Sealand tries to make a new friend: the newest micronation, Wy.
episodes.title: Keep on moving!! March Forward, Sealand!

episodes.synopsis: The Axis Powers celebrate the first anniversary of the Tripartite Pact.
episodes.title: It's the First Anniversary! The Tripartite Pact
